summary_short.zh: Win11Debloat是一款PowerShell脚本工具，专门用于清理Windows 10/11系统中的预装软件和遥测功能，帮助用户简化系统环境并增强隐私控制。其技术核心在于通过自动化交互式命令行界面，提供安全可控的系统修改方案，让用户能够按需移除冗余组件。开发者可以运行脚本来优化个人电脑，调整配置以适应特定工作流程，或借鉴其模块化设计思路来学习PowerShell系统管理技巧，实现更高效的操作系统定制。

summaries.en: Win11Debloat is a PowerShell script that helps users remove unwanted pre-installed apps and disable telemetry to declutter and customize Windows 10/11 systems. Its technical strength lies in providing an automated yet interactive command-line interface that safely manages system modifications through well-structured removal routines. Users can run the script to clean their installations, modify its configuration for specific needs, or study its approach to learn PowerShell system administration techniques for personal or professional use.

summaries.en: BettaFish is an open-source multi-agent framework for public opinion analysis that helps users break through information bubbles by collecting diverse perspectives. Its technical innovation lies in using specialized AI agents—each trained for distinct tasks like sentiment detection and trend prediction—to collaboratively analyze data without relying on external frameworks. Researchers can deploy it to monitor social media discussions, journalists might use it to track emerging narratives, and developers can extend its agent architecture for custom analysis pipelines.

summary_short.zh: Claude Skills 是一个开源项目，提供 169 个生产就绪的插件，用于扩展 Claude Code 等 AI 编程助手，涵盖工程、营销、合规等多个领域的专业能力。它展示了如何通过模块化技能设计，在不重新训练核心模型的情况下，将通用编程 AI 转变为领域专家。开发者可通过插件市场直接安装使用，或参考其 Python 实现学习模块化架构，从而为自己的项目创建定制化技能，提升 AI 在特定任务中的实用性。

summaries.zh: Claude Skills 是一个开源项目，提供 169 个生产就绪的插件，用于扩展 Claude Code 等 AI 编程助手，涵盖工程、营销、合规等多个领域的专业能力。它展示了如何通过模块化技能设计，在不重新训练核心模型的情况下，将通用编程 AI 转变为领域专家。开发者可通过插件市场直接安装使用，或参考其 Python 实现学习模块化架构，从而为自己的项目创建定制化技能，提升 AI 在特定任务中的实用性。
summaries.en: Claude Skills is an open-source collection of 169 production-ready plugins that extend Claude Code and similar AI coding assistants with specialized capabilities across domains like engineering, marketing, and compliance. It demonstrates how modular skill design can transform general-purpose coding AIs into domain-specific experts without retraining the core model. Developers can install these plugins via marketplace commands to enhance their AI workflows, or study the Python implementations to create custom skills for their own projects.
